title: fluent create_experiment: a failed trace_location link soft-deletes the new experiment and reports the cleanup outcome honestly
answers: Why does mlflow.create_experiment with trace_location leave an experiment behind when linking fails?
After a failed trace location link, why can't I recreate an experiment with the same name?
Where is the cleanup and error message handled when creating an experiment with a Unity Catalog trace location fails?
If deleting the experiment fails during rollback, what does the error say and is it logged?
body:
Path: mlflow/tracking/fluent.py:create_experiment handles the mlflow.create_experiment(..., trace_location=...) flow: it creates the experiment first, then calls _resolve_experiment_to_trace_location to link it to a trace location (e.g. Unity Catalog); any MlflowException from the link step passes through the except branch here.
Rule: On link failure, call client.delete_experiment(experiment_id) (MlflowClient.delete_experiment in mlflow/tracking/client.py) and track whether that cleanup succeeded with a flag. This is a soft delete: the experiment is lifecycle_stage 'deleted' and its name stays reserved, so it is not a true rollback. If cleanup succeeds, re-raise saying the experiment was soft-deleted and its name remains reserved; if cleanup raises, log a _logger.warning with exc_info=True saying the experiment may remain active, and re-raise a message saying it could not be cleaned up. Never use one message for both outcomes.
Symptom: Users were told to 'delete the experiment and retry', but retrying with the same name failed because the soft-deleted name stays reserved, and the active experiment was left behind. In an earlier revision the re-raised text said the experiment 'was rolled back' even when the delete itself had failed, contradicting the logged warning.
Constraints: Applies only to the trace_location branch of fluent create_experiment. Permanent removal requires `mlflow gc` (per the code comment); do not describe the cleanup as hard-deleting or as making the name immediately reusable. Does not change MlflowClient or the stores.
applies: Fluent mlflow.create_experiment calls that pass trace_location and fail during linking; not for other create paths or for delete_experiment called directly.
says: Cannot reuse an experiment name after creating it with a trace location fails.
Failed experiment creation claims it rolled back but the name remains taken.
Error message when linking a trace location does not explain why retry fails.
Why does creating an experiment with trace storage leave a reserved experiment behind?
Clarify whether an experiment was soft deleted or left active after setup failed.
search: In mlflow/tracking/fluent.py:create_experiment with trace_location, a failed link triggers client.delete_experiment soft-deletion and reports the cleanup outcome distinctly. If soft deletion succeeds, the re-raised exception states the experiment was soft-deleted and its name remains reserved; if deletion fails, a warning logs with exc_info=True and the error states it could not be cleaned up. This applies only to the trace_location branch of fluent create_experiment without modifying MlflowClient or stores, and the cleanup must not be described as hard-deleting or making the name immediately reusable.
